profile.jobTitle: Sr. Software Dev & Engineering - Full Stack Developer (DevX Observability)
profile.summary:
Highlights of Technical Career - Full Stack Developer
•	20+ years experiences in the design, implement the Complex, High Performance, Distributed-Parallel system applications in Network Management System. 
•	Lead, Managed the Developer Offshore team.

Technical Background
•	Proficient in Lead Engineer, Java OOD, J2EE, Rest Services, Web Services, Otel Tracing, Clickhouse Distributed, Redis, Grafana, SOLJ, CouchDB, ElastichSearch, NodeJS, Angular,  Typescript, Javascript, Functional Language, Postgres, MongoDB, Python, Unix Shell Scripting, Helm Chart, Terraform, Jenkins CI/CD, Networking (SNMP, Syslog, TL1 Protocols, Firewall, Cyber Security).
•	Experiences in AWS, Kubernetes, Langfuse AI, OpenLayer, MCP, GitHub Action, Java Mobile, C/C++, Docker, Azure, Xerxes, Ruby On Rail, JQuery, Ansible CI/CD, Jenkins, Ansible Vault, JSP, BRIX, NetCool, NetExpert,  AB Intio, MySQL, Oracle, Perl.

positions.title: Sr. Software Dev & Engineering - Full Stack Developer (DevX Observability)
positions.description:
MAPLE (Massive Analytics Platform for Logging CDN Caching Events) team.  

•	Lead CDN Analytic Maple UI/API team
•	Implement/Enhance CDN Analytic Maple UI, API, Clickhouse Distributed DB 
        for internal/external customers to access CDN Traffic Control Analytic Data Logging.  
•	Design/Implement Maple API Multi-threaded, Caching mechanism in GSLB Data Centers. 
•	Design/Implement Maple SSO MSAL Authentication Service
•	Design/Implement/Integration Maple Grafana Azure SSO Security Authentication 
•	Design/Implement/Integration Maple Grafana Dashboards for Maple external customers
•	Implement Auto-discovery/Monitoring out-of-sync in hundreds of DDL servers API
•	Design/Implement Clickhouse AI/ML 
.       Implement Langfuse OSS
 
Technologies: C/C++, Langfuse, HyperDX, Clickhouse Parallel Distributed DB, NodeJS, Loopback4, Angular8, Go Lang, Java OOD, Rest Services, Typescript, Functional Language, Javascript, Python, Kafka, Postgres, MongoDB, Kubernetes Rancher (CD) Ansible/Vault (CI), Xerxes, Azure, Jenkins, Grafana, Apache Airflow, Apache Traffic Server Caching Logging Protocols.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer (Java, J2EE, Networking Programming, DB, UNIX)
positions.description:
•	Lead, Design and Implement the complex Network Management System to support Fault Alarming, Inventory,  Automation, Caching Storages
•	Design and come up with Solution
•	Design, Implement the complex, high performance, distributed parallel applications
•	Design, Implement from end2end systems
•	Working with IP, Transport, Voice, CDN  
•	Design, Implement in new technologies (Monfox, SOLJ, Redis, ElasticSearch, CouchDB)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java, Networking Programming, Rest/Web Services, DB)
positions.description:
•	Design, Implement Network Probes in Multi-Threaded Java to interface with various Network Protocols such as: TL1 Monfox, SNMP, SNMP Trap, Syslog, Nortel EAI, SSH, Telnet, Email to support NMS Fault, Inventory, Provisioning
•	Implement NID, LMS (Network Inventory Data, Location Management System) applications 
•	Lead, Design, Managed and provide the solution for the developer Offshore team to implement ICS (Intelligent Configuration System) TL1 Monfox application to support NMS system. 
•	Working in EMS systems such as NetCool,  NetExpert 
•	Design, Implement various Automation systems to monitor the Network
•	Design, Implement Rest Services 
•	Design, Implement UI in JQuery, JSP

positions.title: Software Engineer (Java, C/C++,Python, Perl,  Unix )
positions.description:
•	Enhance, Implement Distributed Parallel DCE  (Data Collection Engine) to support ~100 collector servers to support IP Billing Usage 
•	Implement,  Support Data Warehouse IP billing data processing in AB Initio ETL tool
•	Implement,  Support BRIX, SMART SLA applications
